$comment: A PROPOSAL, NOT A WRITE. `taxonomy/misconception-families.json` carries status 'DRAFT — families are a design artifact and need Sean's read before mass authoring cites them', and assigning all 66 of the bank's free-text misconceptions to those 14 families is exactly the mass citation that line holds. So this file is the evidence for that read. Nothing here has been applied to any item; the misconception-taxonomy gate still FAILS on all 66, which is the honest state.
status: DRAFT — awaiting Sean's read of the family taxonomy, then historian review
draftedBy: Claude. An authoring agent may not approve its own work, and a family assignment is a claim about what a student believes.
appliesTo: the 66 distractors that fail `misconception-taxonomy` today — every one of them carrying a free-text misconception with no family
whyItMatters: `apply_authoring.py` stamps `provenance.authoring`, which is what makes `misconception-taxonomy` begin judging an item. So the governed repair path CREATES this failure: 20 of the 22 affected items were written by it. Until a family can be written alongside the rationale, every repair adds findings. The tool now accepts a family (see `tools/apply_authoring.py`); what it is waiting on is permission to cite.

findings.finding: ONLY 33 OF 66 RESOLVE CLEANLY. 13 are approximate, 1 needs two families at once, 6 are not families at all, and 13 do not resolve. A taxonomy that half-fits is not a taxonomy that needs more careful mapping — it is a taxonomy with a gap, and forcing 66 assignments would record 33 real diagnoses and 33 guesses in a field the analytics layer is built to trust. Nothing downstream could tell them apart.

THE MISSING FAMILY IS POLARITY REVERSAL, and it is the single biggest cluster: 12 of the 13 unresolved distractors are one error — the student has the DIRECTION of a policy, relationship or alliance backwards. 'reverses which bloc the satellite states belonged to'; 'imposed control read as voluntary partnership'; 'an arms build-up read as an agreement to disarm'; 'the direction of federal involvement under the New Deal'. MC-F-04 (Causation reversal) is about cause and effect and does not cover it, and filing these there would make 'reverses cause and effect' mean two different things in one report — which is the aggregation failure the taxonomy exists to end. Proposed: a 15th family, 'Polarity reversal' — the student has the direction of a relationship, policy or alignment inverted; reteach shape is sorting statements into for/against, imposed/voluntary, toward/away.

proposedAddition.name: Polarity reversal
proposedAddition.statement: The student has the DIRECTION of a policy, relationship or alignment inverted — imposed read as voluntary, restriction as expansion, one bloc for its opposite.
proposedAddition.diagnostic: The chosen option is the accurate statement with its direction turned around.
proposedAddition.reteachShape: sorting statements into for/against, imposed/voluntary, toward/away — direction cards, not re-teaching the content

findings.finding: SIX OF THE 66 ARE NOT BELIEFS AT ALL, AND THE TAXONOMY HAS NOWHERE TO PUT THEM. 'contradicts the source, which documents abundant recruited labour' and 'invents a time limit the treaty does not contain' and 'answers a comparative-ideology question that was not asked' describe what the OPTION DOES, not what the student BELIEVES. A family is a reasoning error a student carries between items; 'this option contradicts the stimulus' is a property of the item. They are two axes and one field is holding both, so an analytics report aggregating on family would mix 'students who reverse causation' with 'distractors we wrote to contradict the passage'. Proposed: a SECOND axis, `distractorFunction` — what the option does (common-misconception · partial-truth · right-answer-wrong-question · plausible-fabrication · contradicts-stimulus) — with a family REQUIRED only when the function is `common-misconception`. Two of the five candidate functions (surface-cue, implausible) would be item FLAWS rather than legitimate functions.

A RECURRING SHAPE THE 14 ALSO MISS: MEANS TAKEN FOR ENDS. 'mistakes a method of assimilation for its purpose' and 'mistakes an instrument of the New Deal for one of its three aims' are the same error and are currently filed to MC-F-04 and MC-F-13 respectively — two families for one confusion, which is the aggregation failure again, quieter. Three occurrences is thin evidence for a 16th family; noted so the next round can count rather than re-derive.

MC-F-07 (Presentism) IS WRITTEN IN ONE DIRECTION ONLY — 'applies present-day values... to historical actors'. PS-0067's 'assumes excavation was manual' is the reverse: the student assumes the past was LESS capable than it was (the Culebra Cut was dug with steam shovels). Filed MC-F-07/approximate. Widening that statement to cover both directions costs nothing and would make one assignment clean.

ONE DISTRACTOR NEEDS TWO FAMILIES. PSTIM-0124/C — 'credits the president in office at completion rather than construction' — is a wrong ACTOR (MC-F-02) caused by wrong TIMING (MC-F-01). The schema takes one. Either is defensible and the choice changes what a report says the student needs. Flagged rather than decided.

whatIsNotProposedHere: No item is modified. The 66 findings stand.
No family is added to taxonomy/misconception-families.json — F2 and F3 are proposals for Sean's read, and a model adding a family to a taxonomy it was asked to apply would be approving its own work.
No IRT or calibration claim. Family assignment says nothing about item difficulty.
